geo.cost: You earned the press, but AI cannot confirm you own the trail.
geo.finding: You have a genuine asset most shops lack: real editorial coverage (Atlanta Magazine, WhatNow Atlanta, AccessAtlanta) that AI reads. But with no LocalBusiness schema and an "Atlanta" title, AI cannot verify you are the plant shop on the Eastside Trail, so it hedges.

aitest.finding: Your press means AI can name you, but for "plant shop near the Beltline" it is not the certain pick. Run all 9 phrasings live (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) and log each engine.

corpus.finding: Strong on editorial (Atlanta Magazine, WhatNow Atlanta, AccessAtlanta, Wanderlog); thin on review volume (26 on Yelp) and on the Beltline.org and Discover Atlanta guides AI cites.

lists.finding: Named in Atlanta plant shop round-ups, but framed as an Atlanta shop, not "the plant shop on the Eastside Trail." Verify inclusion and rank in the 2026 AtlantaHits best plant nursery list.

schema.finding: No LocalBusiness schema detected in the page HTML; the address and Beltline mention live in body copy only. No geo or "on the Eastside Trail" signal a machine can read.

aeo.cost: Good plant answers, but nothing you publish claims the trail.
aeo.finding: You already run a Plant Care FAQ, better AEO than most shops. But none of it claims the Beltline or the Eastside Trail, so you do not own the "plant shop near the Beltline" answer.

qa.finding: Check the Google profile for open, owner-unanswered questions, then seed your own (parking, workshops, Burle's Bar upstairs, plants along the trail).

qcontent.finding: A Plant Care FAQ and common-questions content are already live, a real strength. Add Beltline, Eastside Trail, and "visiting on the trail" questions.

answers.finding: Nothing on the site owns "plant shop on the Atlanta Beltline" or "Eastside Trail plant shop." Burle's Bar carries the trail story, but it is a separate brand and does not answer the plant query.

verdict: You have what money cannot buy: a plant shop physically on the Eastside Trail, a real founder story, and a cocktail bar named for a botanist. But your Shopify title says only "Atlanta," you publish no LocalBusiness schema, and there is no brand video carrying the room online, so AI cannot confirm you own the trail you stand on. Fastest fix: put "Eastside Trail, along the Beltline" in your homepage title and schema, film one brand piece, and the press you already earned starts pointing straight to you.
